10.source_text: Some inquire, “Is this community going to be destroyed by thieves?” No. But they have their agency, and their course affords us an excellent opportunity to see the operation of the benign influences of so-called “civilization.” Do you suppose that I am now looking upon thieves? No: they do not come to meeting. Those who are for right are more than those who are against us. More will prove…
